final_message: Edited only docs/ja/specdojo/rulebooks/utc-index-rulebook.md. Fixed F001 (DB exception restated in the boundary/dependency chapter now references the exclusion table), F002 (all 10 case-table columns are required in a fixed order; unresolved `トレース`/`証跡` cells must state they are provisional), F003 (purpose text now matches the case-table common columns), F005 (diagram node names match the deliverable names) and F006 (`_UNDECIDED_` note for the undecided recipe/template and the sample mismatch). Renamed chapter 5 to 本文要件, removed the サンプル chapter, and added good/bad examples to three guide sections. F004 (sample structure mismatch) is out of scope for this stage and is handed off.
handoff: F004 not fixed: docs/ja/specdojo/samples/utc-index-sample.md does not follow the rulebook's 本文要件 chapters 1-9. The plan forbids editing the sample in this stage, so the follow-up `sample-maintenance` should align its headings and order (also remove the Markdown links in its H1 and body).

The サンプル（最小） chapter was removed because the plan says the rulebook must not hold a completed example. rulebook-authoring-standard says existing rulebooks should not remove this chapter ahead of others in an individual revision; please confirm which rule takes precedence.

F006: the frontmatter declarations (`recipe: undecided`, `template: undecided`) are unchanged per the plan; the `_UNDECIDED_` note in 全体方針 must be removed once they are decided (template is handled by PJR-WYTX).
